text:
ravi: FYI product just confirmed Cormorant-P2 public beta goes live in APAC next Wed (ap-northeast-1 + ap-southeast-1). Need capacity sketch and quick cost delta so infra can prep. Expected profile: ~2.15x token/sec vs our current hosted baseline, median seq ~880, 95th ~1200.
cheng: Thanks. H100 only for hosted or can A100 quant do?
maria: Product prefers H100 for p50 latency targets. A100-quant suggested only for Dedicated customers who accept slightly higher p50. Hosted needs H100 to keep p50 ~80ms at 1k tokens.
jessica: Quick perf math from our bench: Cormorant-P2 at batch=8 -> ~410 tok/s per H100 for seq~900. With 2.15x, effective per-H100 demand drops to ~882 tok/s. If baseline hosted is 140k tok/s, new peak ~301k tok/s -> ~735 H100s.
ken: That's significant. Can we mitigate with KV prefix caching and increased batching? Product says many requests are similar prompts.
ravi: Plan outline: 1) Short-term hosted surge capacity for launch window 2) Dedicated pre-warm options and nudges to pin to smaller variant for cost-sensitive customers 3) Fallback to Cormorant-Mini for non-critical routes.
sre-oncall: Note quota limits: ap-southeast soft quota ~110 H100 equivalents. If we need >200 in APAC we'd have to file quota increases now (3-5 business days).
cheng: Propose 70/30 traffic split NEA/SEA for provisioning. Open quota req for SEA immediately and prepare cross-region failover to us-west for overflow.
maria: Cost estimate: assume 720 H100-equivalents for hosted sustained surge for 72 hours -> 51,840 GPU-hours. At blended rate ~$0.85/hr equiv -> ~$44k for the 72hr period. If sustained monthly, that's ~1.6M GPU-hours -> huge.
jessica: We can reduce effective token/sec by enabling aggressive KV caching + bumping batch window to 12ms on non-latency-critical routes. Pilot data suggests up to ~28% reduction in token/sec needs.
ken: Can we run an emulator micro-sim: 50 H100s + caching turned on to validate reduction? If it shows ~25% drop we save hundreds of GPUs.
ravi: Yes. Ops, can you stand up a canary pool (50 H100 in ap-northeast) and wire a staging route with prod-synth traffic (seq distribution matched)?
ops-bot: @infra request created: REQ-4102 4 H100s provision (pool=cormorant-canary, region=ap-northeast-1). ETA: 20 hours.
sre-oncall: Networking caveats: cross-region failover to us-west adds ~15-30ms tail latency and extra egress costs. Also watch NAT gateway bandwidth and ephemeral IP limits in ap-southeast during cold spikes.
cheng: For Dedicated accounts, recommend toggles to pin to Cormorant-Mini by default and allow opt-in to full P2. Rollout with 24-48h canary windows.
maria: I'll draft customer comms with cost impact matrix and degrade options for pay-as-you-go customers.
ken: Action items: (A) File quota request for ap-southeast (ravi) (B) Canary run: 50 H100 + caching (cheng + ops) (C) Prewarm 200 H100-equivalents if product confirms 72hr sustain (ops) (D) Full cost & GA decision by EOD tomorrow (maria).
ravi: Also consider spot fallback for non-SLA routes to soak unexpected burst, with explicit flag to disable for SLA customers. Ops, can you add policy flag?
ops-bot: @infra config updated: spot_fallback_non_sla = true (default=false for SLA-customers).
jessica: I'll run perf tests including seq tail at 1.2k to validate p95/p99 impact  should take ~6 hours.
sre-oncall: If quota increases are delayed we'll gate APAC traffic via rate-limiter rules and enable cross-region draining to prevent noisy-neighbor amplification.
ravi: Keep metrics here. Upload canary perf logs to /mnt/infra/cormorant-canary once ready. Post canary numbers and we'll reconvene. :thumbsup:
